scheme_name: HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund
fund_type: Open-ended Fund of Fund scheme investing in units of HDFC Gold Exchange Traded Fund (ETF)

lock_in_period.description: Nil. There is no statutory lock-in period for this fund of funds scheme.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.25% (investors also bear the underlying ETF scheme expenses).

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is applicable if units are redeemed or switched out on or before 15 days from the date of allotment. No exit load is payable if redeemed after 15 days.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum investment amount is ₹100 for initial as well as additional purchases.

taxation.tax_regime: Specified Mutual Fund / Debt & Commodities Taxation rules as per applicable Finance Act provisions based on holding duration and investor tax slab.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Download statements via Groww Profile > Reports > Mutual Funds or through HDFC AMC / CAMS online facilities.
operations.folio_lookup: Accessible in your Groww portfolio and consolidated account statements (CAS).
